adjudication.evidence: Both P1 (day 589) and P2 (day 595) are single-day spikes with no sustained offset or return phase. Original N/E/U show a large step at ~594–595 (U drops ~18 MAD, N jumps ~30 MAD, E +10 MAD) followed by persistent post-step motion—not a temporary platform. No evidence of opposing return across same axes; interior observations after day 595 remain offset without recovery. Hypotheses P1/P2 subtract only onset offsets but do not produce a closed loop or stable plateau—residuals still show the step as permanent. Single-day candidates cannot constitute a temporary platform per definition.
